headline: President Prabowo Convenes Coalition Leaders To Address VP Vacancy
seoTitle: Prabowo Meets Coalition Leaders Over VP Replacement
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto met with coalition party leaders at Bogor Palace to deliberate on the selection of a new vice president following a resignation.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto gathered coalition party leaders at Bogor Palace to discuss the vice presidency.
The meeting follows the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming Raka from the position.
A final decision regarding the new vice presidential candidate is expected within one week.
aiContextParagraph: Following the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming Raka, President Prabowo Subianto held a series of meetings at the Bogor Palace with leaders of the ruling coalition parties. The objective of these consultations is to determine a successor for the vacant vice presidential seat. Multiple party heads confirmed receiving invitations for the gathering, which took place alongside relevant government ministers. Reports indicate that the selection process for a new candidate is currently underway, with the administration planning to announce the outcome following the President's scheduled official state visits. The discussions are intended to reach a consensus among the allied parties regarding the transition of leadership at the executive level.
whyItIsViral: The story has achieved a high viral activity score due to rapid coverage across major Indonesian news outlets following the vacancy in the country's second-highest office.
